name: p2-tlc-consensus
cmd: unset GDP_CYCLIC_LOG; set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; python3 research/verify-all/tlc-audit-run-20261109.py consensus 1800000 > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.log" 2>&1; cp -r runs/verify-all/tlc-evidence-consensus-* "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/evidence"; jq -e '.tlc.complete == true and .tlc.exit == 0 and .tlc.violated == false and .port.exit == 0 and .port.result.done == true and .port.result.bad == 0 and .port.result.states == .tlc.states and .port.result.edges == .tlc.edges and .broken.exit == 0 and .broken.result.bad > 0' "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/evidence/result.json"; jq '{id,tlc,port,broken}' "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/evidence/result.json"
